name: What are the tradeoffs between luxury vinyl plank and tile in a kitchen?

mainEntity.name: What are the tradeoffs between luxury vinyl plank and tile in a kitchen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tile offers unmatched water resistance, fire resistance, and durability against heavy wear, but it creates a hard, unforgiving surface that can tire feet during long cooking sessions. Dropped dishes almost always shatter on tile. Luxury vinyl plank provides a softer, warmer feel underfoot with excellent sound dampening and complete waterproofing at a generally lower installation cost. However, vinyl can be gouged by dragging heavy appliances, whereas properly installed porcelain tile can easily last decades without scratching or fading.
acceptedAnswer.description: Tile offers maximum scratch and heat resistance but is hard and cold. LVP is warmer, quieter, and budget-friendly, though sharp edges or heavy moving appliances can gouge it.
